q1_issues.issue: (Member pirates team) types a proper noun from world knowledge — the text supplies no kind word for "Pirates".
The appositive title "Pirates manager" has no tense of its own and should take the past host clause's wrapper, i.e. (Past (Member lloyd_mcclendon manager)), not a bare atom.

(Member sk_players_1 quality) predicates the modifier of the group symbol, which the plural rules bar — a descriptive modifier must distribute over the members, or the pair must fuse into the group's kind slot.

q2_gaps: direct quotation / quoted speech ("...," said X) — the attitude machinery is defined for a finite that-complement, and nothing says whether a verbatim quote is sealed the same way or kept as a string
first- and second-person pronouns ("we") — the pronoun rules enumerate he/she/they/it only, and a quoted "we" has no antecedent in the reported sentence, only in the speech situation
notes: Resolving "we" to the pirates symbol is a defensible salience choice but rests on the speaker's identity rather than on a textual antecedent, so it sits inside the coverage gap above. Holder/Theme for "have got" and the unmarked (no-status) present stative are both correct.
